title: Attila the Hun to Squidward: how?
description: A Raphael fresco, the line of popes, two White House visits and a Hollywood ceremony connect Attila the Hun to Squidward, through his voice, Rodger Bumpass.
hook: How is Attila the Hun connected to Squidward?

image.file: File:Raphael - The Meeting of Leo the Great and Attila.jpg

links.line: Around 1514, Raphael painted Attila the Hun meeting Pope Leo I.

links.line: In 2013, 221 popes after Leo, the line reached Pope Francis.

image.file: File:Pope Francis and Joe Biden at the White House.jpg

links.line: In 2015, Francis met Vice President Joe Biden at the White House.
In 2024, Biden welcomed Star Wars legend Mark Hamill to the Oval Office.

image.credit: Getty Images for Paramount Pictures, via Mulderville

links.line: In 2025, Hamill posed with the SpongeBob cast, including Rodger Bumpass.
And since 1999, Bumpass has voiced the grumpy Squidward.
